newsitem.title: USA: Premier Bancshares Inc completes merger.
newsitem.headline: Premier Bancshares Inc completes merger.

text.p: Thrift holding company First Alliance Premier Bancshares Inc said on Monday it had completed its share-for-share merger with Central and Southern Holding Co.
The resulting organization, which is based in Atlanta, Georgia, will continue to operate as Premier Bancshares Inc, the company said in a statement.

In addition, Premier Bancshares said Central and Southern's chief executive officer, Robert Oliver, will move to the holding company headquarters in Atlanta to serve as president and chief operating officer of Premier Bancshares.
"The merger improves our stock liquidity with Premier now having approximately 8 million shares outstanding," said Premier chief executive Darrell Pittard.
Premier Bancshares Inc said it has total assets of roughly $544 million.
